title: Starlight Estate Ontology
_role: Vocabulary, not storage. This file names the node kinds, edge relations, and invariants of the estate accountability graph. It is a PROJECTION over existing sources (agents/*.md frontmatter, ontology/company-registry.json, ontology/repo-tiers.json, skills/skill-rules.json). It is not a fifth graph under docs/graph-engineering/CONTRACT.md, not an SSOT, and not per-agent — one graph holds every agent. It extends foundry/contracts/capability-graph.schema.json with the accountability dimension that schema lacks.

company.doc: An accountable business unit. Has a P&L or an explicit no-revenue declaration. Owns brands and repos. NOT a legal entity — see 'entity'.

entity.doc: A legal entity (BV, Ltd, sole trader). Zero or more companies route through one entity. Public file carries name + role only; jurisdiction, cash, and tax posture stay private.

brand.doc: A register — a voice, a palette, a claims posture. A company may hold several. VOICES.md is authority for voice; this node only binds brand to company and to its COPY.md pin.

repo.doc: A git repository. Exactly one company owns it. Carries a tier (T0-T3) that decides whether a session installs it.

surface.doc: A place the estate meets a human — a domain, a storefront, a channel, a community.

agent.doc: A registered agent card under agents/. Mirrors the capability-graph 'agent' node and adds accountability edges.

skill.doc: Encoded expertise. Mirrors the capability-graph 'skill' node unchanged.

decision-right.doc: A named authority to decide. The unit that makes an executive seat real. Every decision-right is held by exactly one seat and names its human gate.

metric.doc: A number a seat is answerable for. A seat without a metric is decoration.

vault.doc: One of the six SIS memory vaults. Layer B per docs/graph-engineering/CONTRACT.md. Referenced, never duplicated.

owns.doc: Ownership is exclusive. Two companies never own one repo.

routes-through.doc: Commercial routing. Public graph records the edge, never the terms.

accountable-for.doc: The accountability edge the capability-graph has no word for. Only executive-tier agents may originate it.

escalates-to.doc: Must terminate at human. Cycles are a build failure.

instantiates.doc: A C-suite seat is a definition instantiated per company, not a global singleton. company:arcanea instantiates agent:starlight-cmo scoped to arcanea.

writes.doc: A write edge without a matching human_gate on an irreversible decision-right is a build failure.

invariants.rule: Every repo node has exactly one owning company.
Every company has exactly one agent holding accountable-for on it, and that agent's tier is 'executive'.
escalates-to forms a DAG terminating at a human node. No cycles.
Every executive seat owns at least one metric. A seat with zero metrics is decoration and fails the build.
Every decision-right marked reversible:false names a human_gate.
Every repo with tier T0 or T1 has agents_md.state == 'generated' — hand-written AGENTS.md is allowed only at T2/T3.
No node carries a monetary amount, jurisdiction, counterparty name, or credential. Those live in private/ and are never graphed.
Every brand names the COPY.md pin it is governed by.
Every agent in agents/ appears in the graph, or is explicitly listed in unregistered[] with a reason.

non_goals: A second orchestrator. Hermes/Queen remains schedule and lease authority.
A graph per agent, per skill, or per domain. One estate graph.
A memory product. Layer B stays the six vaults.
